## Golang v1.22 Details


  
Provides a production-ready HTTP server and client through the standard library (net/http) for building web applications, REST APIs, and services.  

  
Supports basic HTTP request routing using http.ServeMux. More advanced routing requires third-party libraries.  
  
  
Provides native JSON serialization and deserialization through the encoding/json package.  
  
  
Includes a robust HTTP client for consuming REST services and external APIs.  
  
  
Provides a basic logging package (log). Structured logging is available through the standard log/slog package in newer Go versions.  
  
  
Provides generic SQL database access through database/sql. Database-specific drivers are supplied separately.  
  
  
Supports database transactions through the database/sql package.  
  
  
Includes first-class unit testing, benchmarking, fuzz testing, and code coverage through the standard testing package.  
  
  
Includes a complete toolchain with dependency management, testing, formatting, documentation, and compilation.
